prusa_core_one.calibration_basis: Measured off Prusa's CAD (the CORE One has no printer of ours to check it on; the CORE One L, made the same way, was checked on the real machine in F02). Front = CAD -Y (door, display), machine X along CAD +X, machine Y along CAD +Y, Z up. Bed sheet CAD x -132.41..119.59, y -150.01..90.99, top z 78.44; the nozzle tip is the lowest point of the hotend part at CAD (-1.17, -57.94, 329.00). X0 is 1 mm inside the sheet's left edge, Y0 5 mm behind its front edge (the margin measured on the CORE One L; an estimate here), Z0 the sheet touching the nozzle. The CAD's X rail is 310 mm and the head is wider than its carriage, so at the very ends of X the head draws a few millimetres past the beam.

Motion groups follow the model's own assemblies (tools/printer-cad/prusa-mk3s/groups.json): the Y-axis moving components are the bed, the X-axis assembly the gantry that climbs, the extruder assembly the head.
Belts and cables keep their CAD shape.
prusa_mk3s.scope: Movement preview from the live position; firmware, belts and collisions are not simulated.
prusa_mk3s.calibration_basis: Measured off the community CAD of the MK3 (no MK3 here to check it on). Front = CAD -Y (the LCD), machine X along CAD +X, Y along CAD +Y (the bed moves toward the front as Y grows), Z up (the X axis and the extruder climb). SS sheet CAD x -125.24..126.76, y -178.61..62.39, top z 77.18; the nozzle tip is the lowest point of the E3D V6 at CAD (-21.66, -47.47, 179.78). X0 is 1 mm inside the sheet's left edge, Y0 5 mm behind its front edge (the margin measured on the CORE One L; an estimate here), Z0 the sheet touching the nozzle. The X-end blocks of this CAD are closer together than the printer's travel, so at the two ends of X the head draws 7 to 14 mm into them.

prusa_mini.calibration_basis: Measured off the community CAD of the MINI (no MINI here to check it on). The STEP is Y-up: machine X runs along CAD -X, machine Y along CAD +Z (the bed moves toward the front, CAD -Z, as Y grows) and Z along CAD +Y; the display box is at CAD -Z, the front. Heatbed CAD x -125.40..60.60, z -192.03..10.37, top y 44.29; the nozzle tip is the lowest point of the hotend at CAD (-41.30, 59.70, -93.40). X0 is 3 mm inside the plate's left edge, Y0 5 mm behind its front edge (the margin measured on the CORE One L; an estimate here), Z0 the plate touching the nozzle. The MINI's extruder is fixed on the Z carriage (it pushes filament through a short tube), so it climbs with the gantry and only the hotend and fans ride the X axis. The X axis of this CAD is 16 mm shorter than the plate is wide, so at X0 the head draws into its end block.
